Please Note : 
1. Minimum gap of plaster to be maintained with respect to masonries done with :- 

(a). Red Clay Bricks - No restrictions.

(b). Fly Ash - Plaster to be done only after air dry time of 60 to 75 days (as per weather)
                                                                                                             
(c). Only dry blocks to be used, adhesive and RCC band to be used as / detail.

2. Plaster work to be done only using coarse sand.

3. If average thickness of plaster found to be more than 20mm, please discuss with omaxe structure team for workable solution.

4. Chicken wire mesh to be fixed in such a way that a gap of 7-8 mm may get created between wall and wire mesh in order to sandwiched it properly.

5. Wet mortar to be consumed within 1 hour of it's preparation.

1. Minimum gap (in days) to be maintained between wall erection and plaster with respect to masonaries done with :- 

(a). Red Clay Bricks - No restrictions.

(b). Fly Ash - Plaster to be done only after air dry time of 60 to 75 days (as per weather)
                                                                                                             
(c). Only dry blocks to be used, adhesive and RCC band to be used as / detail.

4. Chicken wire mesh to be fixed in such a way that a gap of 7-8 mm may get created between wall and wire mesh in order to sand witched it properly.

5. Wet mortar to be consumed within 1 hour of it's preparation.

Please Note : 
1. Minimum gap (in days) to be maintained between wall erection and plaster with respect to masonaries done with :- 

(a). Red Clay Bricks - No restrictions.

(b). Fly Ash - Plaster to be done only after air dry time of 60 to 75 days (as per weather)
                                                                                                             
(c). Only dry blocks to be used, adhesive and RCC band to be used as / detail.

2. Plaster work to be done only using coarse sand.

3. If average thickness of plaster found to be more than W/O specifications, please discuss with omaxe structure team for workable solution.

4. Chicken wire mesh to be fixed in such a way that a gap of 7-8 mm may get created between wall and wire mesh in order to sand witched it properly.

5. Wet mortar to be consumed within 1 hour of it's preparation.

Please Note : 
1. Minimum gap (in days) to be maintained between wall erection and plaster with respect to masonaries done with :- 

(a). Red Clay Bricks - No restrictions.

(b). Fly Ash - Plaster to be done only after air dry time of 60 to 75 days (as per weather)
                                                                                                             
(c). Only dry blocks to be used, adhesive and RCC band to be used as / detail.

2. Plaster work to be done only using coarse sand.

4. Chicken wire mesh to be fixed in such a way that a gap of 7-8 mm may get created between wall and wire mesh in order to sand witched it properly.

5. Wet mortar to be consumed within 1 hour of it's preparation.

1. Minimum gap (in days) to be maintained between wall erection and plaster with respect to masonaries done with :- 

(a). Red Clay Bricks - No restrictions.

(b). Fly Ash - Plaster to be done only after air dry time of 60 to 75 days (as per weather)
                                                                                                             
(c). Only dry blocks to be used, adhesive and RCC band to be used as / detail.

2. Plaster work to be done only using coarse sand.

4. Chicken wire mesh to be fixed in such a way that a gap of 7-8 mm may get created between wall and wire mesh in order to sand witched it properly.

5. Wet mortar to be consumed within 1 hour of it's preparation.

Please Note : 
1. Minimum gap of plaster to be maintained with respect to masonries done with :- 

(a). Red Clay Bricks - No restrictions.

(b). Fly Ash - Plaster to be done only after air dry time of 60 to 75 days (as per weather)
                                                                                                             
(c). Only dry blocks to be used, adhesive and RCC band to be used as / detail.

2. Plaster work to be done only using coarse sand.

3. If average thickness of plaster found to be more than 20mm, please discuss with omaxe structure team for workable solution.

4. Chicken wire mesh to be fixed in such a way that a gap of 7-8 mm may get created between wall and wire mesh in order to sandwiched it properly.

5. Wet mortar to be consumed within 1 hour of it's preparation.
